nodes.prompt:
Dedicated Background Run Orchestrator for implementing the Streamlined Edge Information System, Static/Highlight Edge Dynamics, and Node Dimension Bounds across `skills` and `gvui`.

Repositories:
- `skills`: `/Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/skills`
- `gvui`: `/Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui`
Harness CLI: `bun ~/.agents/skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/harness.ts`
Capsule Directory: `/Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui/.capsules/2026-08-15-gvui-streamlined-edges-and-bounds`

### Authoritative Planning Specifications:
- `skills/docs/planning/gvui-execution-graph/06-host-telemetry-and-agent-detection-plan.md`
- `skills/docs/planning/gvui-execution-graph/07-high-performance-wasm-layout-and-pure-projection-plan.md`
- `skills/docs/planning/gvui-execution-graph/08-streamlined-edge-system-and-traffic-drawer-plan.md`

### Core Engineering Invariants:
1. Zero direct chatter to main chat. All subagents you deploy must report strictly to you.
2. Initialize run capsule: `plan:init --repo /Users/onurseckinsenoglu/repos/gvui --run-id 2026-08-15-gvui-streamlined-edges-and-bounds`
3. Plan and execute the following tasks using parallel worker/validator pairs:

#### Task T-01: Skills Host Telemetry & Strict Type Compliance (`skills`)
- Scope: `skills/orchestrating-long-tasks/scripts/src/summary/`
- Fix `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` typing in `asset-mapper.ts`, `edge-builder.ts`, `host-telemetry.ts`, and `graph-generator-helpers.ts`.
- Ensure `bun test tests/unit` and `bun run typecheck` pass with 0 errors.

#### Task T-02: Streamlined On-Canvas Edge Badge Overlay (`gvui`)
- Scope: `gvui/src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/EdgeBadgeOverlay.tsx`
- Remove all decorative icon rendering (`IconComp`).
- Remove on-canvas token chip rendering (`edge-traffic-chip`).
- Render clean typography: pure numeric step badge (`2` or `3 -> 2`, never `"Step"`) + action title (`displayText`).
- Ensure hover cursor pointer and click handler opening the Edge Detail Drawer.

#### Task T-03: Static by Default, Animated Highlight on Selection (`gvui`)
- Scope: `gvui/src/primitives/edges/GraphEdge/GraphEdge.css`
- Ensure all default edge paths and markers are **static, solid, and clean** (remove continuous background dash animations on unselected edges).
- Enable cut-off animated dashed lines (`stroke-dasharray: 6,4` flow animation) **only** when `.is-highlighted` or `.selected`.

#### Task T-04: Deep Inter-Node Call Trace & Payload Drawer (`gvui`)
- Scope: `gvui/src/components/EdgeDetailDrawer/`
- Top summary card: Inter-Node Call Count (e.g. `Called 4 times across Steps 2, 3, 4`).
- Chronological exchange flow: Step-by-step trace of what context/prompt was sent, what findings/diffs were returned, and resolution proofs.

#### Task T-05: Node Dimension Bounds (Min 200px, Max 500px, Unconstrained Height) (`gvui`)
- Scope: `gvui/src/engine/layout/custom/config.ts`, `gvui/src/engine/layout/measurement/`
- Set `minNodeWidth: 200`, `maxNodeWidth: 500`.
- Maintain unconstrained, uncompressed height accumulation in `canvasMeasurer.ts` and `nodeTemplate.ts`.

#### Task T-06: Verification, Re-Export & Sealing (`gvui`)
- Run all test suites in both repos (`bun test` in `skills` and `gvui`).
- Export capsule summary to `public/data/graphs/2026-08-15-gvui-streamlined-edges-and-bounds.json` and register in `manifest.json`.
- Complete critic review (`critic:start`, `critic:review`) and seal capsule (`run:complete`).
- Format and commit both repositories.
